verdict.rationale: Greenhouse exposes a webhooks system covering many recruiting events (application created/deleted, candidate hired, candidate merged, etc.) that can trigger external actions, which satisfies the 'event-triggered automation' need, but there's no evidence of a native in-product rules/automation engine where an AI-native user can define conditional logic without external scripting or a third-party integration layer. Missing for 10: a documented native rules-builder UI, conditional logic beyond simple event subscription, and evidence of AI agents directly authoring/managing these triggers.
